---
title: "M2 - Video Anonymization Component"
---

## Overview

Module M2 - Video Anonymization is a reusable Packaged Business Capability (PBC) of the Villanova project.
It enables organizations to protect personal and sensitive information in video streams and recordings through configurable anonymization policies.

M2 is designed to support privacy-by-design adoption in business and public-sector scenarios where video data must be processed responsibly.

## Business Capabilities

M2 provides the following high-level capabilities:

- Automated anonymization of sensitive visual elements in video content
- Policy-driven configuration for different risk and compliance contexts
- Admin-driven configuration with no technical skills required for standard setup
- Reusable integration in composable application ecosystems
- Delivery as a standalone capability or embedded module in larger workflows

## Business Value

M2 is intended to support organizations that need to:

- Reduce privacy and compliance risk in video processing pipelines
- Standardize anonymization policies across teams and use cases
- Accelerate time-to-value for compliant video analytics and archiving
- Enable non-technical administrators to manage anonymization behavior

## Ethical and Regulatory Considerations

M2 follows a responsible-by-design approach aligned with data protection and AI governance expectations.

Key principles include:

- Data minimization and purpose limitation in video processing
- Human oversight for policy definition and exception handling
- Transparency on anonymization behavior and operational limitations
- Traceability of configuration and policy changes
- Support for compliance workflows in regulated environments

Each deployment should be validated against applicable legal and sector-specific obligations.
